items.title: Wildfires in south-west France flare up as region braces for new 40C heatwave
items.description: Firefighters are braced for a sharp rise in temperatures on Wednesday, which could complicate the containment of wildfires in Gironde.

items.title: Uefa and PM criticise Infantino World Cup plan
items.description: Uefa and Prime Minister Andy Burnham criticise proposals from Fifa to seek private investment in its competitions, including the World Cup.

items.title: Ghana mourns its tallest man - a 'generous and popular giant'
items.description: Sulemana Abdul Samed, who was diagnosed with gigantism several years ago, has died at the age of 33.

items.title: Mysterious deaths of 14 elephants in Kenya prompts urgent inquiry
items.description: It is the highest number of elephant deaths to be recorded in this area of southern Kenya in decades.

items.title: Odyssey translator writes scathing review of Nolan film adaptation
items.description: The film has won rave reviews from film critics but a translator of Homer's work was less than impressed.

items.title: The cocaine superhighway from Ecuador to Europe - the BBC reports on gangs and the police fightback
items.description: The BBC goes on patrol with Ecuador's police, who are grappling with a huge surge in drug crime.

items.title: US walks out of UN Security Council meeting during France's remarks
items.description: The row sparked after the US joined North Korea and Russia in voting against extending the term of the UN high commissioner for human rights.

items.title: 'A lover of life' - Seattle pays tribute to food festival shooting victims
items.description: Families grieved on Monday as they remembered the three people killed in a shooting at a food festival.

items.title: 'A narcissist' - victim's family blasts Kohberger for challenging Idaho murder conviction
items.description: The man accused of killing four students in Idaho is taking back his plea, which was made to avoid the death penalty.

items.title: Hong Kong activist allowed to stay in UK after deportation threat
items.description: Wu was detained for hours at London's Heathrow Airport last week and refused entry, he told the BBC.

items.title: French Navy carries out 'shooting drill' mid interview
items.description: Shadow Home Secretary Chris Philp says the vessel fired 17 shots as he was giving a BBC interview.

items.title: Mancini reappointed Italy boss after Pirlo controversy
items.description: Roberto Mancini is appointed Italy manager for a second time - just a day after Andrea Pirlo rules himself out of the running for the job and technical director Paolo Maldini resigns.
